title: FauxAI
summary: A Streamlit web application for generating synthetic medical tabular data, letting users train custom CTGAN or TVAE models on uploaded data and inspect quality/diagnostic reports. It is built directly on SDV's single-table synthesizers, metadata objects, evaluation functions, and the standalone sdmetrics reporting API.
